name: The title translates to "My Whole Family was Reborn, so it's not too Much for Me to be Arrogant, right?
original_name: The title translates to "My Whole Family was Reborn, so it's not too Much for Me to be Arrogant, right?
overview: The plot revolves around a businesswoman who, after being reborn along with her family, decides to abandon her ambitions and pursue her former nemesis.
